# awrecover

> Labelled snapshots with an all-or-nothing restore.

A restore that half-succeeds is worse than one that fails, because you now have a state that never existed.

## Install

```
pip install awrecover
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Snapshot one directory, break it, restore it, diff it.

## Composes with

- [awnix](https://aitherium.github.io/awnix/) — A Linux you can hand to an agent — immutable base, capabilities included.
- [awshare](https://aitherium.github.io/awshare/) — Publish an artifact and fetch it back verified.
- [AitherZero](https://aitherium.github.io/AitherZero/) — PowerShell 7+ automation framework — numbered, self-describing scripts.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awrecover
- Docs: https://aitherium.github.io/awrecover/

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awrecover.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
